name: vitest-setup-files-in-every-argument
description: A configuration file's default export written as a call is read in every argument of the call, so a Vitest configuration that merges a base object with its test options names its setup files in the second argument: each is a test file, and a helper only it calls is used only by tests, which is production code only tests use and so carries the class possible. The fixture assumes the analyzer carries a row named vitest for the package vitest whose range holds the installed version and which reads setupFiles from the test object of vitest.config.ts.
